tasks.label: py: validate ips strict
tasks.command: python3 -m pip install --quiet jsonschema && python3 scripts/validate_ips.py --strict

tasks.label: py: serve (background)
tasks.command: (pgrep -f 'http.server 9000' >/dev/null && echo 'server already running') || (nohup python3 -m http.server 9000 >/tmp/uap-serve.log 2>&1 & disown; sleep 1; echo 'server started on :9000')

tasks.label: js: syntax check
tasks.command: node --check script.js && node --check editor.js && echo JS_OK
